title: Livestock Disease Control Methods Explained 2023 Edition Nyoike Live Lesson 01 09 23 Part 10
reason: The video discusses various methods of livestock rearing practices and disease control, which are real-world agricultural processes.

tasks.task: Explain the different methods of parasite and disease control in livestock.

subtasks.text: Describe the process of deworming, including the use of drenching guns.
Explain the method of dipping for controlling external parasites.
Describe the pasture management techniques for controlling parasites.

tasks.task: Describe other livestock management practices for disease control.

subtasks.text: Explain the method of docking to control blue fly infestation.
Describe the hoof trimming process to control hoof rot diseases.

tasks.task: Describe the methods of vaccination used in livestock.

subtasks.text: Explain the process of administering a vaccine through injection.
Explain the inhalation vaccination method for pottery.
List the types of vaccines discussed in the lesson.
Explain the properties of a good vaccine.
Mention the assignment given at the end of the lesson.
